source: Adda247 CBE exam-screen export (candidate response-sheet PDF) of the actual SSC CHSL 2023 (2023-24) Tier I screen - header 'Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2023 Tier I', Exam Date 02/08/2023, bearing per-question SSC Question IDs and one candidate's Status/Chosen Option: https://www.adda247.com/jobs/wp-content/uploads/sites/22/2025/07/09181130/SSC-CHSL-2023-02-08-2023-Shift-IV-Paper.pdf (accessed 2026-08-24; linked from Adda247's SSC CHSL PYQ page https://www.adda247.com/jobs/ssc-chsl-previous-year-question-paper/ which lists this date with Shifts 1-4).

corroborating_sources.name: Adda247 CBE exam-screen exports, same date Shifts 1-3 (files SSC-CHSL/2023/2023-08-02_Shift-{1,2,3}.json in this repository)
corroborating_sources.note: Genuine CBE exports of the same exam series and date (different shifts), each with its own distinct SSC Question ID set - corroborates that four shifts were actually held on 02-Aug-2023 and the CBE screen conventions used here. NOT a question-level source for this file.

corroborating_sources.name: Testbook - SSC CHSL 2023 Question Paper listing
corroborating_sources.note: Independently lists CHSL Tier-1 2023 papers for 02 Aug 2023 with the 100 Questions / 200 Marks / 60 Mins pattern, corroborating the existence of this date. (Testbook's actual paper PDFs are login-gated; not used as a question source.)

notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (header Exam Date 02/08/2023, SSC Question IDs + one candidate's responses throughout), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment: the English section (Q1-25) is recovered (some options image-only; Q3's Question-ID line fell on a page boundary and is missing; Q14 options contain the sic 'fail' wording); the Reasoning section is almost entirely image-only except Q29 option text (ELI/ZGD/NXR) and Q28 stem (full-width bracket sic) and Q38 symbol fragments; the Quant section is image-only except Q58 (geometry angles + options with key mark), Q62 (trig expression), Q65 (17^3-7^3 expression + options), Q71 (garbled option set), Q66 (bar-graph average stem + options 50/60/80/30) and Q67 (pie-chart sports spending stem + options); the GA section is image-only except Q88 (free-enterprise economy), Q89 (microfinance regulator), Q90 (Sher Shah's Tomb) and Q91 (Maharashtra social-justice association) with full stems + options; GA Q.17-24 (global 92-99) carry recovered SSC Question IDs + one candidate's Status/Chosen Option lines (final chunk re-fetched 2026-08-24) but image-only question bodies; GA Q.25 (global 100) is absent from the PDF's text layer (the document ends at GA Q.24). Everything else is marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] and has NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. RESOLVED SOURCE-AVAILABILITY ISSUE + CORRECTION LOG (2026-08-24): in the initial build the final chunk of the source PDF (GA section-questions 17-24, global 92-99) consistently returned S3 AccessDenied while chunks 0-3 retrieved successfully, so those globals were marked NOT RECOVERABLE with no SSC Question IDs, and two Question-ID lines encountered earlier in the parse (264330144478, 264330146002) were provisionally positioned at global 92/93. On 2026-08-24 the final chunk became retrievable; chunks 3-4 were re-fetched continuously (chunk 3 ends with the GA Q.16 block, ID 264330148591, and chunk 4 begins with the GA Q.17 block), establishing GA Q.17=264330145716 (Answered, Chosen 2), Q.18=264330150353 (Answered, Chosen 1), Q.19=264330150428 (Not Answered), Q.20=264330150049 (status line cut off), Q.21=264330154804 (Answered, Chosen 3), Q.22=264330145880 (Answered, Chosen 3), Q.23=264330151328 (Answered, Chosen 1), Q.24=264330149940 (Not Answered) = global 92-99, all with image-only question bodies. The previously positioned IDs 264330144478 and 264330146002 do not appear anywhere in the fully re-fetched text layer of this PDF (all 5 chunks re-verified) and are treated as parse artifacts; they are attributed to no question. GA Q.25 (global 100) does not exist in the PDF's text layer (document ends at GA Q.24) and remains NOT RECOVERABLE. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I: 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25); this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question where present. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENTS (listed, NOT attached): (a) Reasoning - an options fragment '1. / 2. / X 3.' appearing between two isolated Question-ID lines (264330146997, 264330146478) whose own question headers were not parsed; attribution between those two questions cannot be established; (b) Quant - a mixed-fraction option set 7 2/3, 6 2/3, 5 2/3, 8 2/3 (re-fetch position: text gap between the Quant Q.8 (global 58) and Q.9 (global 59) blocks, together with (c); not attached); (c) Quant - a DI table 'Name | Unit test 1-4: Rani 20 22 24 23; Raju 22 18 24 20; Ravi 24 22 20 24; Rekha 20 21 22 23' (re-fetch position: same gap as (b)); (d) Quant - a fragment 'A=63/65' (re-fetch position: same gap as the Q62 trig expression, between the Quant Q.12 (global 62) and Q.13 (global 63) blocks); (e) Quant - area-like fragments 242√3 and 121√3 (the latter rendered '∨3.121√3', a probable check-mark rendering artifact); these appear in the same gap directly after the Quant Q.25 (global 75) block as the angle option set now attached to Q75, but are NOT attached because Q75 already carries a 4-option angle set and their true owner cannot be established. LEAKED-FRAGMENT ATTRIBUTION CONVENTION: text-layer fragments that appear directly after a question's own Question-ID + Status block are attributed (as 'probable') to that question, because the following question in every such case carries its own complete ID + Status block; this is a layout inference, flagged per-question. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only; they are NOT official answers. KEY-MARK ARTIFACTS: some source tables embed check-mark / 'X' marks next to options (Quant Q58, Q66, Q67). These are Adda247's answer-key notation inside the export; they are UNVERIFIED against the SSC official key, so they are recorded in answer_note only and never used to set correct_answer. ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment, so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null.
